p.espaces.cu_d: Customs, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not provide customs declarations: a licensed customs broker (freight forwarder) can do this for you, but he must be authorized to perform customs formalities.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UN-WTO): Duties and Rules for Nearly Every Country
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): Customs, Duties, Rules of Origin, Step by Step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs code (HS code) and duties on entry into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_t4: French Customs: EORI, customs clearance, simulators
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport document: Waybill (Sea), Air Waybill (Air), CMR (Road)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of origin (to obtain reduced duties)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (for companies importing or exporting to the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: health or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer arranges everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller hands over the goods to the buyer's carrier after export customs clearance
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: The seller loads the goods on the ship; the risk and cost then pass to the buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: The seller pays the freight and insurance costs until the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: The seller delivers to the destination and the buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: The seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Forbidden or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeit goods, protected species (CITES), some medicines. Such lists are rejected and can be reported.
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr Always check the exact rules for your product.

p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: find a supplier, find out the real price, comply with the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means you sell a product that the supplier sends directly to your customer. It’s easy to get started, but you remain responsible for the sales.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is authorised in your customers’ country: no counterfeits, no unauthorised regulated products.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier (Wholesale/supplier listings here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the real price: product, shipping, customs, customer's country VAT, payment fees and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Let your customers know the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your business: company status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see Trade Rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect consumer rights: clear prices including taxes, right to return, guarantee, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A supplier who wants full payment by unsecured bank transfer or cryptocurrency.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to get rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: prohibited and punishable.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a shipment from non-EU countries pays VAT from the first euro.
